description: This Java class, RatesHelper, provides utility methods for interacting with rate-related API endpoints in the Fineract project, including retrieving, creating, updating, and generating JSON payloads for rates.

classes.name: RatesHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage rate entities in integration tests, such as fetching, creating, updating rates, and generating JSON payloads.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Fetches the list of rates from the server.

methods.name: createRates
methods.description: Creates a new rate on the server with given request payload.

methods.name: getRateById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific rate by its ID.

methods.name: updateRates
methods.description: Updates an existing rate identified by its ID with provided JSON request.

methods.name: getLoanRateJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for loan rate with default parameters.

methods.name: getLoanRateJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for loan rate with specified productApply and percentage values.

methods.name: populateDefaultsForLoan
methods.description: Creates a default HashMap with sample rate data for testing.

methods.name: getModifyRateJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON string for modifying a rate, specifically setting percentage to 15.0.
